banner.title: recyclarr
banner.tagline: Syncs TRaSH Guides quality profiles and custom-format scores into Radarr and Sonarr once a day, so release ranking is kept in Git.

explainer.title: Scores come from Git, not from the app UI

steps.title: Config
steps.text: The recyclarr.yml ConfigMap lists which TRaSH profiles and custom formats each *arr app receives.
steps.scene: a configuration card with a list of tags

steps.title: Fetch
steps.text: Recyclarr reads the TRaSH Guides data and matches every profile and format by its trash_id.
steps.scene: a branching tree of guide documents

steps.title: Score
steps.text: It creates or updates the profiles and scores in Radarr and Sonarr, and deletes custom formats the file no longer declares.
steps.scene: three score sliders set on a dashboard

steps.title: Assign
steps.text: It never moves a movie or a series to another profile. Which profile a title uses is app state in Radarr and Sonarr.
steps.scene: a title card placed on one of several profile shelves

facts.label: score for a release with no English audio
